This site tracks sea ice extent and thickness across regions off Alaska, aligned with 
Large Marine Ecosystems supported by AKFIN. Explore how sea ice changes over time, 
check recent conditions, and download data for further analysis.

## Regions and the Marine Ecosystems

In federal fisheries management, the Alaska region is made up of distinct large marine ecosystems across the Gulf of Alaska (GOA), Aleutian Islands (AI), eastern Bering Sea (including the northern Bering Sea), and Chukchi and Beaufort Seas (referred to here as the Alaskan Arctic). Fishery management areas include the Gulf of Alaska and Bering Sea/Aleutian Islands. No federal fisheries currently occur in the Alaskan Arctic.
